name: Ryan Carter - WB1 Core World - Approved
description: Runtime-optimized stable world lore for Ryan Carter's bodyguard route. All entries are keyword-only and non-constant. WB1 defines people, institutions and locations; it does not manufacture plot events. Conditional incidents, schedules and threat progression belong to WB2. Continuity, information ownership, used-event flags and state firewalls belong to WB3. [FILL IN] values are intentionally unspecified and may be generated naturally when first required, then should remain consistent with established roleplay continuity.

entries.name: Global World Vitality
entries.content:
GLOBAL WORLD VITALITY

The world continues beyond {{char}} and {{user}}.

NPCs have their own work, classes, friendships, families, plans, conversations, obligations and moods. They may naturally enter or leave scenes when their location, schedule or relationship makes that plausible.

Locations remain populated and functional. Students attend classes, staff work, vehicles arrive and leave, phones receive ordinary messages, businesses operate, families talk and mundane life continues around the protection detail.

Not every background occurrence is connected to the stalker.

Do not turn ordinary strangers, staff, students or passing vehicles into threats without relevant event logic.

The main character remains {{char}}. World activity supports his route rather than replacing it.

entries.name: Mia Park
entries.content:
MIA PARK

Mia Park is {{user}}'s closest female university friend.

She is warm, quick, casually funny and comfortable enough with {{user}} to text without ceremony. She knows {{user}}'s normal university rhythm and naturally supports class reminders, room changes, saved seats, coffee, lunch, ordinary conversation and Tuesday family dinner.

Mia may become genuinely worried by repeated unexplained missed classes or unusual silence, but she is a friend rather than a caretaker.

She may also appear in ordinary Saturday plans when plausible.

Mia has her own life and friendship with {{user}}. She does not constantly ship {{char}} and {{user}}, manufacture romantic situations or magically know what happened privately.

entries.name: Sophie Grant
entries.content:
SOPHIE GRANT

Sophie Grant is one of {{user}}'s female friends from her wider social circle.

She is polished, extroverted and socially informed without being a caricatured gossip.

Sophie naturally supports brunch, shopping, cafés, gallery openings, parties, formal invitations and Saturday social plans.

She understands wealthy and high-profile social environments well enough to notice when an event is likely to be crowded, photographed or socially important.

She has no mechanical relationship tracker and reacts naturally to what actually happens.

entries.name: Jade Morgan
entries.content:
JADE MORGAN

Jade Morgan is {{user}}'s practical, energetic female friend.

She naturally supports gym visits, active plans, casual food, errands and spontaneous Saturday outings.

A typical Jade invitation may be as simple as:

[ From: Jade ]
*gym at three?*

Jade provides an organic path into gym scenes, but she does not know that any stalker-related event may occur there and her presence never automatically activates one.

She has no mechanical relationship tracker.

entries.name: Mama and Papa
entries.content:
MAMA + PAPA

MAMA
{{user}}'s affectionate socialite mother.

Appearance:
- mature, elegant blonde woman
- warm light skin
- hazel/brown eyes
- refined feminine features
- shoulder-length blonde hair usually styled into polished waves or an elegant updo for formal events
- graceful, glamorous presentation
- favors sophisticated high-society fashion, especially fitted evening gowns, fine jewelry and polished formal styling

Personality / role:
Mama is socially capable, affectionate and involved. She is accustomed to charity events, formal invitations and wealthy social circles. She calls {{user}} "Pookie Bear."

Mama has her own established socialite circle:
Names: [FILL IN]
Appearances: [FILL IN]

PAPA
{{user}}'s affectionate father and owner of Xenox Inc.

Appearance:
- mature, handsome light-skinned man
- brown hair heavily threaded with silver
- neatly groomed salt-and-pepper beard
- hazel/green eyes
- broad, masculine features
- polished, expensive presentation
- usually dresses in tailored businesswear or formal black tie for major events

Personality / role:
Papa may appear polished and authoritative in business settings, but he is openly affectionate and emotionally softer with his family. Sunday family time matters strongly to him.

The family hired professional protection because the threat to {{user}} is genuine, not because either parent wants to control her ordinary life.

Neither parent automatically knows {{user}}'s private romantic or sexual developments.

entries.name: Familia GC
entries.content:
FAMILIA GC

Use compact phone formatting when family messages naturally appear:

[ From: Familia GC ]
Mama: *message*
Papa: *message*

Messages may include invitations, reminders, family chatter, social logistics, concern or ordinary mundane conversation.

Do not write {{user}}'s reply or decide whether she accepts an invitation.

entries.name: Protection Team
entries.content:
PROTECTION TEAM

{{char}} is the primary close-protection agent on {{user}}'s detail, but he is not the only competent professional involved.

ELENA TORRES, 32
Qualified relief close-protection agent. Calm, capable and professional. She can genuinely take over {{user}}'s protection when {{char}} is relieved. She is not a romantic rival.

MARCUS REED, 39
Operations/team lead. Coordinates staffing, threat briefings, incident response and major protection operations. He may disagree professionally with {{char}}, order him to rest or formally relieve him from the detail.

DANIEL BROOKS, 34
Protective driver and security-support specialist. Handles vehicles, transport, movement logistics and related support. He is not a magical hacker or instant technical solution.

The wider firm may provide additional ordinary personnel when operationally necessary, but do not constantly invent named elite agents.

entries.name: Family Home
entries.content:
{{user}}'S FAMILY HOME

A large contemporary smart estate centered on privacy, warmth and actual family life rather than sterile display wealth.

Visual language:
- pale stone
- warm wood
- large windows
- soft indirect lighting
- deep comfortable furniture
- integrated smart-home systems
- lived-in family objects

Technology includes automated climate and lighting, motorized curtains, smart glass, concealed speakers and integrated property security.

LIVING ROOM
Large sectional, deep armchairs, recessed television, blackout curtains, concealed surround sound and warm evening lighting. Sunday family movie time normally happens here.

KITCHEN
Large warm modern kitchen with oversized island, hidden appliances, induction, smart ovens, coffee station, pantry and casual seating.

DINING ROOM
Elegant but intimate. Tuesday family dinner with Mia normally uses this space.

PAPA'S HOME OFFICE
Warm darker wood, construction drawings, architectural models, Xenox documents, secure workstation and concealed displays.

SECURITY ROOM
Professional but comfortable room containing property cameras, gates/access status, alarms, perimeter information, secure communications, workstations, equipment storage, good seating, coffee and a small refrigerator.

Early in the route, {{char}} normally works from the security room while the family has Sunday movie time nearby.

PRIVACY
No legitimate cameras exist in bedrooms, bathrooms or inappropriate private spaces.

entries.name: User Residence
entries.content:
{{user}}'S RESIDENCE

{{user}} has an upscale independent smart residence.

Do not define {{user}}'s personal decorating style, bedroom aesthetic, collections or possessions unless she establishes them.

The residence includes modern access control, smart locks, video intercom, automated lighting/climate, smart curtains or blinds and appropriate public/common-area security.

Before {{char}}'s assignment, the stalker entered the residence, photographed {{user}} asleep inside her bedroom and left without stealing valuables.

The sleeping photograph and original intrusion are established historical facts. Do not replay or rediscover the intrusion as a new event.

No legitimate cameras exist inside the bedroom or bathroom.

{{char}} considers the residence compromised until professionally reassessed.

entries.name: University
entries.content:
UNIVERSITY

Name: [FILL IN]

A large affluent modern university combining older academic buildings with newer smart facilities.

Relevant spaces include lecture halls, seminar rooms, library, campus café, student common areas, landscaped walkways, study spaces, administrative buildings and parking/drop-off zones.

Technology may include student-ID access where appropriate, digital class information, campus Wi-Fi, public-area CCTV and normal emergency infrastructure.

The university is busy and imperfectly observable. Crowds, visitors, multiple entrances and ordinary public movement exist without making the campus incompetently unsafe.

{{char}} normally uses low-profile protection here: nearby walking position, waiting outside lectures, a useful café position, route observation and vehicle coordination rather than sitting beside {{user}} through every class.

Campus scenes should remain capable of being ordinary student-life scenes.

entries.name: Gym
entries.content:
GYM

A premium smart fitness and wellness club blending high-end comfort with modern performance facilities.

Visual language:
warm stone, dark wood, greenery, acoustic panels, ambient lighting and large windows.

Facilities include:
- free weights
- strength machines
- cardio
- functional training
- stretching areas
- studios
- café/lounge
- optional recovery facilities

Smart systems support member access, locker assignment, bookings and some equipment profiles.

WOMEN'S CHANGING ROOM
Private, warm and spa-like with electronic lockers, benches, private changing areas, showers, vanity stations, towels and secure storage.

No cameras exist inside changing rooms, showers or other private areas. Appropriate CCTV may cover entrances, reception, public corridors, lobby/elevator and parking access.

The gym remains a normal reusable location. Mentioning or entering it does not automatically trigger a stalker event.

entries.name: Safehouse
entries.content:
SAFEHOUSE

An outwardly discreet high-end contemporary residence intended for protected clients who may need to live there for days or weeks.

The interior is intentionally cozy rather than bunker-like: warm oak, soft stone, muted textiles, rugs, deep seating, understated art and warm lighting.

ENTRY
Secure vehicle arrival through enclosed/protected garage access with layered authentication and monitored exterior approaches.

LIVING ROOM
Modular sofa, blankets, television, integrated speakers, shelves, soft lamps and smart privacy glass.

KITCHEN
Fully equipped smart kitchen with pantry, refrigerator, induction, smart oven, coffee machine, filtration and island seating.

BEDROOMS
Several separate comfortable bedrooms with climate control, blackout curtains, adjustable lighting, storage and charging.

{{user}} has her own room.
{{char}} has his own room.
Relief-agent accommodation exists.

There is no architecturally forced one-bed trope.

OPERATIONS ROOM
Secure communications, exterior camera feeds, access logs, alarms, protected workstations and equipment storage.

SECURITY
Exterior cameras, perimeter sensors, controlled locks, smart glass, automated exterior lighting, backup power, environmental monitoring and secure garage access.

The safehouse is secure without feeling like a prison and domestic without automatically implying romance.

entries.name: Xenox Inc.
entries.content:
XENOX INC.

Xenox Inc. is Papa's successful construction and development company.

Its work may include major commercial, residential and infrastructure projects.

HEADQUARTERS
A polished modern corporate environment using stone, glass, warm wood, architectural models, project displays, smart conference rooms and controlled access.

Working areas remain visibly functional with plans, site information, material samples, schedules and ordinary employees.

PAPA'S EXECUTIVE OFFICE
Formal and business-facing, containing secure work systems, project drawings, construction models, meeting space and controlled document storage.

Xenox possesses plausible historical records involving former partners, contractors, business events, projects and professional contacts.

The stalker once had a business relationship with Papa through Xenox Inc.

Merely visiting Xenox or searching old material does not automatically identify the stalker.
